description: Submit the XDR your own wallet signed for a signing request. This is the claim: the account, trustline, USDC and XLM land in that one transaction. Submitting the same signed XDR again is safe (idempotent). Accepts only the signed transaction envelope, never a secret key. "submitted" is not delivery: poll stellar_wallet_order_status until completed. If it answers template_expired or failed, call stellar_wallet_get_signing_request again and sign the new XDR.

signedXdr.description: Signed transaction envelope, base64, as returned by your wallet. NOT a secret key.

name: stellar_wallet_submit_signed
title: Submit the signed Stellar transaction
